mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand and business investment, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST above 75th percentile historical distribution leads to negative 20-day returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 2.5% signals tight monetary policy, suppressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 2.5% leads to positive 20-day returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and strong retail sales (RSAFS > 520000) indicate a robust economy with strong consumer demand and low labor market slack, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 3.5% and RSAFS > 520000 leads to negative 20-day returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) signals Federal Reserve tightening, increasing discount rates and suppressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% leads to positive 20-day returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (INDPRO) indicates a contraction in manufacturing, signaling a weakening economy and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 leads to positive 20-day returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 3.5% (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market, likely to lead to wage inflation and monetary tightening, suppressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 3.5% leads to positive 20-day returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105) indicate a strong economy with low unemployment and robust manufacturing, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 3.5% and INDPRO > 105 leads to negative 20-day returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE 3-month change < 0) indicates a tightening labor market, leading to wage growth and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE 3-month change < 0 leads to negative 60-day returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
